description: A surgical services administrator must allocate the hospital's only portable negative-pressure wound-therapy unit between two patients preparing for discharge tomorrow and finalize the alternate dressing, equipment delivery, and home-health arrangements for the patient who does not receive the hospital unit.

shared_context.S1: Patients Rowan and Ellis are both expected to leave the surgical service tomorrow and both are being considered for the hospital's only portable negative-pressure wound-therapy unit.
shared_context.S2: The portable unit can support one patient at a time after discharge.
shared_context.S3: Marisol makes the binding equipment allocation and documents the care plan for both patients.
shared_context.S4: The unit's routine process requires a multidisciplinary huddle with wound care, infectious disease, durable medical equipment, and home health before a discharge-related equipment allocation is finalized.
shared_context.S5: During this huddle, each named representative gives a verbal readout before Marisol can finalize; if a representative says they have information to add, the huddle pauses for that representative's readout before the decision proceeds.

PF1.text: Patient Ellis's wound-care order requires continuous negative-pressure therapy at exactly -125 mmHg for the next 72 hours; standard moist dressings are not an acceptable substitute during that period. Evan verified the order at bedside, but it has not yet been entered into the discharge equipment field.

PF2.text: Patient Rowan can safely use saline-moistened gauze twice daily until an outpatient rental device arrives, with the first dressing change due tomorrow morning. Dr. Shah documented this temporary alternative in an infectious-disease addendum that is still pending signature.

PF3.text: The insurer has approved Patient Rowan's outpatient negative-pressure device rental, and the supplier has confirmed delivery to Rowan's home at exactly 09:00 tomorrow. Lena received the confirmation directly from the supplier, but it is not yet in the equipment queue.

PF4.text: Home health has confirmed Patient Rowan's dressing-change visits for exactly 07:00 and 19:00 tomorrow while the temporary gauze plan is in effect. Noah reserved those visits by phone, but the agency's scheduling portal has not synchronized them yet.

acceptance_conditions: The hospital portable unit must be assigned to Ellis.
The negative-pressure setting must be exactly -125 mmHg.
Patient Rowan's interim dressing plan must include saline-moistened gauze twice daily.
The plan must record delivery of Rowan's outpatient device at exactly 09:00 tomorrow.
The plan must record Rowan's home-health dressing visits at exactly 07:00 and 19:00 tomorrow.
The wound-care order requiring Ellis's therapy must be cited as justification.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Ellis's exact -125 mmHg continuous order makes Ellis the required recipient of the hospital unit and changes the documented setting from unspecified to -125 mmHg.
Rowan's confirmed tolerance of saline-moistened gauze twice daily changes Rowan's alternate plan from unspecified dressing care to a plan containing that exact interim regimen.
The insurer approval and supplier confirmation change Rowan's equipment plan from an unresolved alternate arrangement to a documented device delivery at exactly 09:00 tomorrow.
The agency's confirmed reservations change Rowan's home-support plan from unspecified follow-up to dressing visits at exactly 07:00 and 19:00 tomorrow.
